cases.title: repo removal of a repository with carry rows and no entities deletes the carry rows
with returnIncomingToPending, a hand-written edge from repository A into B is a pending row of A awaiting the entity after B is deleted, counted in A's state; B's own edge is not returned
a failure inside the delete transaction leaves both B's rows and A's edge untouched
without the option the delete is as before: the edge is removed and nothing is returned to pending
